title: About
description: Neil Smith Construction Ltd. is a heavy civil contractor based in Richmond, BC, founded in 2018 on over fifty years of excavation and heavy civil experience.

hero.title: Heavy civil.
hero.subtitle: A heavy civil contractor based in Richmond, BC, serving municipalities, school districts and builders across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley.

image.alt: NSC crew placing detention tank modules with CAT excavators behind, Guildford Park

blocks.title: Founded on fifty years in the field.
blocks.text:
Neil Smith and Dennis Frederickson started Neil Smith Construction in 2018. Neil brought over fifty years in excavation, heavy civil and agricultural work, from small backfill jobs to major highway projects with crews of fifty or more. Dennis brought decades of experience in residential and commercial construction and project management.

After Neil’s passing in 2022, Dennis took over leadership of the company and has guided it through steady growth: from utility upgrades and bulk excavation to school district programs, municipal sewer separation and specialized public facilities.

Today the company carries the standards it was founded on: quality work, delivered safely, on time and on budget.

blocks.text: You’re only as strong as your weakest link.

blocks.title: Our values.
blocks.intro: The standards the company was founded on, and the ones every new team member is held to.

items.title: Quality
items.text: We build to a high standard, the first time, and stand behind it.

items.title: Safety
items.text: Everyone goes home safe. Safe work is efficient work.

items.title: Schedule and cost
items.text: We plan carefully and deliver on time and on budget.

items.title: Teamwork and learning
items.text: We keep learning and we work as one team, office to field.

blocks.title: The people accountable for your project.
blocks.intro: A Senior Project Manager on every project, a dedicated estimating division and superintendents with decades in the field.

blocks.title: Structured for major projects.
blocks.intro: Every job is run by a full project team, from the first estimate to the final as-built.

items.title: Estimating
items.text: A dedicated estimating division prices tenders, prequalifications and change work for municipal, school district and private clients.

items.title: Pre-construction
items.text: Traffic management plans, local bylaws and Good Neighbour programs are reviewed and in place before we mobilize.

items.title: Project management
items.text: A Senior Project Manager on every project, with a dedicated Project Manager running it day to day.

items.title: Field operations
items.text: Site superintendents and foremen lead the crews, with Trimble GPS grade control and digital reporting on site.

items.title: Quality and close-out
items.text: Coordinators manage QA/QC records, RFIs, testing and as-builts through to handover.

items.title: Safety
items.text: COR certified, with a Construction Safety Officer and a toolbox meeting at the start of every shift.

blocks.title: Across the Lower Mainland.
blocks.intro: Head office in Richmond, yard in Langley, and work from the University Endowment Lands to Chilliwack.
